scope: Offline extraction/branch-choice/headroom-conversion diagnostic on existing ordinary-mixture development trajectories; no operational predictor or warning change
gate: Exactly original observed AND fitter_observed; no new truth-based gate, residual threshold, stale extension or extra history. Unknowns remain in original populations.
replay: Unchanged temporal_probe.acquire and cuda_backend.advance, FP64 CUDA only; append identity to sensor projection to record existing state, not change equations/initial conditions/forcing. Compare all physical sensor samples to archived raw waveforms.
critical_definition: Instantaneous maximum-real-part positive-frequency physically transverse mode at END of each window, follow that endpoint branch across the same 128 samples for slope summaries. This is not a fixed flutter-onset branch. Record within-window dominance switches separately from tracking ambiguity.

tracking.ordering: All positive-frequency eigenpairs, initial frequency order; Hungarian cost normalized eigenvalue displacement plus one minus normalized eigenvector overlap
tracking.uncertainty: A window is unresolved when its branch has any failed tracking edge within its ratio interval; unresolved contrasts not interpreted, counts retained.

correspondence.temporal: RMS frequency distance to fitted linear frequency trend <=1/(127*dt) Hz across exactly same samples; no growth-rate matching gate
correspondence.spatial: Phase-invariant complex coefficient overlap from measured fitted offset/cos/sin basis versus physical projected eigenvector at sample63, using that noise view causal calibration scale
correspondence.ambiguity: No unique match -> B unavailable, never choose branch by margin/error/critical identity.

oracle_features: Endpoint physical alpha, endpoint physical f, unweighted OLS alpha/f slopes over exactly128 samples, alpha/(2*pi*f), SAME measured residual column. No oracle value routes a real predictor.
visibility: Instantaneous physical pair contribution from replay state using full eigensystem decomposition. Report centered critical sensor energy relative to rest and injected noise; coherence/strength is not proof of recoverability.
paired_training: Two paired-support contrasts: A/C on critical-valid source rows, and A/B/C on common matched+critical-valid rows. Identical training rows within each contrast, proper train clean/iid1 only, existing degree1/2 and ALPHAS LODO selection. Separate frozen source ridge6 and framewise comparators; never mix populations to claim a gain.
scoring: Per split/noise/design: all original frames, source fresh, common contrast fresh, boundary(-.02<m<.05), unstable(m<0), farther stable(m>=.10), optimism>.02 in boundary, wrong signs by side on .01<=abs(m)<=.05; unknown counts explicit. Equal-design paired errors, no significance from two held designs.
decision: Conditional oracle improvement on both held designs with primary accuracy targets, reduced dangerous errors and farther-stable MAE noninferiority .005 supports targeted extraction under measured mode support, not transport automatically. Oracle failure leaves calibration/support/map capacity unresolved; no impossibility or all-frame success claim.
limits: Four fitting designs, two repeatedly inspected held designs, no blind confirmation
No new physical cases, neural training, warning calibration, reserved-design scoring or progress increase from oracle/reporting results
